title: Origin story: King Arthur
description: Arthur was the son of Uther Pendragon, raised in obscurity until he drew the sword from the stone and was crowned. With Merlin's counsel he built Camelot and the Round Table's fellowship, wielded Excalibur, and fell at Camlann to Mordred — carried to Avalon to sleep until Britain's need.
